svg.title: HousingFinder — Level 1 data flow diagram
svg.desc: Five numbered processes connect external users and Google services with shared accounts, housing, saved-home, viewing, trust and file data stores. Yellow rectangles denote external entities; numbered rounded boxes denote processes; D-prefixed boxes denote data stores.

text.tspan: Rectangles: external entities · Numbered boxes: processes · D1–D6: logical data stores
Repeated identifiers refer to the same entity/store. Crossing lines are not connections unless an endpoint is shown.
